comments.body: Triage (orphan sweep): RESOLVED — the described test failure no longer reproduces. Fixed on main by commit 81b3b5929423a641cbf9dbf806796599df01d59f ('shockproof-twill-porpoise: fix metric test'), which pins engine_b._METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing tool at tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:100 so the metric-backend skip is deterministic instead of depending on a locally-installed metric tool (the root cause), and strengthens the assertion. Verified now on main @9bdb22f5887: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py -q' -> 5 passed, with the AC5 table showing 'metric ran=0 skipped=1 reasons={no_tool: 1}'. The root-cause ticket 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1 is closed; this ticket and its two siblings (0ba2, 354d, 78f4) all describe the same failure. Closing as duplicate of 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

`tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py::test_full_backend_account_is_present` fails on a
CLEAN `origin/main` (verified at 2613827564 by stashing an unrelated in-flight change and re-running,
then again inside the full `make test` run: 1 failed, 10289 passed, 38 skipped).

## Symptom

```
>       assert engine_b.BACKEND_METRIC in table
E       AssertionError: assert 'metric' in {'opengrep': {'ran': 1, 'skipped': 5,
E         'reasons': Counter({'unsupported_lang': 5})}, 'ast-grep': {'ran': 1, 'skipped': 0,
E         'reasons': Counter()}}
tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:109: AssertionError
```

The reconstructed per-backend table contains the two real backend keys (`opengrep`, `ast-grep`) but not
the key named by `engine_b.BACKEND_METRIC` (`'metric'`). Either the reconstruction no longer emits a
`metric` row, or the test's expectation of a `metric` pseudo-backend is stale.

## Why this matters now

It is the ONLY failure in the full suite, so it will turn CI's `Verified` vote red for every change
that runs the full gate — blocking unrelated work from closing. Discovered while running pre-flight
for story f161 (epic 3147); f161 does not touch grounding.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] the root cause is identified: whether `metric` should still appear in the reconstructed backend
      table, or whether the assertion is stale
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py -q` passes on a clean checkout
- [ ] a test pins the intended per-backend accounting so the same drift fails loudly next time
